# Go-to-market: PawWalk (dog-walker booking, Poznań)

- Channel: Instagram ads targeting dog owners in Poznań, 2,000 PLN over 4 weeks.
- Message: "Trusted dog walkers in 1 tap".
- Goal: 200 paying users in the first month.
- Walkers: 6 signed up, all friends of the founder.
- Pricing: 35 PLN per walk, we keep 20%.
- Measurement: we'll see in the app how it goes.
